meta.title: About — Digital Wealth Partners
meta.description: Who we are: a digital asset wealth manager built by private banking, custody and compliance professionals.
meta.ogDescription: A digital asset wealth manager built by private banking and custody professionals.

about.title: Built for clients who expect custody to be boring
about.description: Digital Wealth Partners was founded on a simple premise: digital assets deserve the same operational discipline as any other part of a serious portfolio.
about.story1: We started in 2019 after watching clients hold significant digital asset positions across a patchwork of exchange accounts, hardware wallets and spreadsheets — with no consolidated view and no credible custody story.
about.story2: Today we administer multi-currency accounts for private clients, family offices and independent advisors, combining institutional custody practice with reporting that fits into existing wealth structures.
about.story3: We are deliberately conservative. We support a small set of liquid assets, we document every balance movement, and we would rather decline a mandate than stretch our controls.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: Give clients one verified, well-controlled home for their digital assets, with reporting they can hand to an auditor.

principles.title: Our principles
principles.body: Custody before yield. Documentation before growth. Clear fees, no hidden spreads, no product we cannot explain in one page.

clients.title: Who we serve
clients.body: Private clients, family offices and advisors who need consolidated digital asset positions alongside traditional holdings.

meta.title: Security & Compliance — Digital Wealth Partners
meta.description: Cold storage, two-factor authentication, multi-approval withdrawals, KYC/AML programme and regulatory disclosures.
meta.ogDescription: Cold storage, 2FA, multi-approval withdrawals and our KYC/AML programme.

security.title: Controls you can put in front of an auditor
security.description: Our security posture is designed around a single question: what happens if any one person, device or vendor is compromised?

coldStorage.title: Cold storage by default
coldStorage.body: The majority of client assets are held offline in geographically distributed storage with tamper-evident key ceremonies. [Placeholder ratio: 97.5% cold / 2.5% operational.]

keyManagement.title: Multi-party key management
keyManagement.body: Signing keys are split across independent custodians. No single individual can construct a valid outbound transaction.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.body: Time-based one-time passcodes are supported on every client account and can be enforced for withdrawals.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.body: Every account completes KYC before transacting: legal name, date of birth, residency and a government-issued identity document.

monitoring.title: Transaction monitoring
monitoring.body: Deposits and withdrawals are screened against sanctions and high-risk address lists before settlement.

records.title: Auditable records
records.body: Every balance change writes an immutable ledger entry showing type, amount, actor and timestamp.

security.aml1: Digital Wealth Partners operates a risk-based anti-money-laundering programme. Before an account may transact, we verify the client's identity, confirm country of residence, screen against applicable sanctions and politically-exposed-person lists, and record the source of funds where thresholds require it.
security.aml2: We retain verification records for the period required by applicable law and re-verify accounts periodically or on a material change in circumstances. We file reports with the relevant authorities where we are obliged to do so, and we may freeze or close an account pending review without prior notice.
security.aml3: Verification statuses used in this platform are <pending></pending>, <verified></verified> and <rejected></rejected>. Accounts may explore the dashboard while pending, but funding and withdrawals are enabled only after verification in a production configuration.
security.disclaimer1: Digital Wealth Partners is presented here as a pre-launch preview and is not currently licensed, registered or authorised by any financial regulator. Nothing on this site is an offer, solicitation or recommendation to buy, sell or hold any digital asset.
security.disclaimer2: Digital assets are volatile, are generally not covered by deposit-insurance or investor-compensation schemes, and may lose all value. Balances, prices, conversion rates and performance figures in this environment are illustrative and must not be relied upon.

meta.title: Frequently Asked Questions — Digital Wealth Partners
meta.description: Answers on custody, verification, deposits, withdrawals, fees, supported assets and account security.
meta.ogDescription: Custody, verification, deposits, withdrawals, fees and account security explained.

faq.title: Questions clients ask before funding
faq.description: If your question is not answered here, our client team will respond within one business day.

custody.a: Assets are held in segregated wallet structures administered by Digital Wealth Partners. Your account ledger records your entitlement per asset, and every movement is recorded with a timestamp and reason.

verification.a: Most identity checks are reviewed within one business day. You can explore your dashboard while your verification is pending; a banner will show your current status.

deposit.a: Choose the asset in your dashboard, copy the deposit address shown for that network, send your funds, then confirm the transfer. Operations reconcile the deposit and credit your wallet.

withdrawal.a: Submit a destination address and amount. The request is screened and approved before settlement. You will see it as pending in your transaction history until it is completed.

assets.a: The assets listed in your dashboard. We deliberately support a small set of liquid assets rather than a long tail, and the list is maintained by our desk.

fees.a: An indicative 0.55% annual administration fee, network cost plus 0.10% on withdrawals, and 0.35% on conversions. See the fee schedule for the full list.

live.a: Not yet. This is a pre-launch preview — balances, prices, deposit addresses and conversion rates are illustrative, and no real funds or blockchain transactions are involved.

twoFactor.a: Yes — two-factor authentication is offered in your security settings and can be required for withdrawals.

meta.title: How It Works & Fees — Digital Wealth Partners
meta.description: Our custody model, deposit and withdrawal flow, supported networks and a clear indicative fee schedule.
meta.ogDescription: Custody model, deposit flow, supported networks and fee schedule.

services.title: How your account works, end to end
services.description: From verification to custody to withdrawal, here is exactly what happens to your assets and what it costs.
services.custodyBody: Client assets are recorded in segregated per-asset wallet ledgers. Each account receives a dedicated deposit address per supported network. Outbound movements require a client request, a compliance check and internal approval before settlement — no single operator can move client assets alone.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.body: You request a deposit address for the asset, send funds on the correct network, and confirm the transfer in your dashboard.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.body: Operations reconcile the incoming transfer and credit your segregated wallet ledger. Your transaction history shows every state change.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
withdrawal.body: You submit a destination address and amount. The request is screened, approved and settled, then reflected in your balance.

services.feesNote: All figures below are clearly labelled as indicative ahead of our final published rate card.
